headlines.title: SomeraRoad Turns Hotel Bossert Into Ritz-Carlton Residences
headlines.summary: SomeraRoad and Marriott are converting a shuttered Brooklyn Heights hotel into The Ritz-Carlton Residences.

headlines.title: Empower Strengthens Marketing Leadership Team with Senior Talent from Meta, Marriott, and Zeno
headlines.summary: Empower today announced four senior appointments to its marketing organization as the company invests in building a more relevant and consumer-focused financial brand. Led by Chief Marketing Officer Sangita Woerner, the marketing organization is focused on strengthening how people understand, experience, and connect with Empower, from the stories they see in the marketplace to the products and services they use.

headlines.title: Marriott (MAR) Stock Looks Overvalued After Its 149% 5 Year Run
headlines.summary: Marriott International has delivered a strong multi year share price run, and investors now have to ask whether the cash being generated by the hotel group is enough to support where the stock trades today. With the valuation lens firmly on its cash flows, the question is how well those future streams of money line up with the current market price. Over the past 5 years, Marriott International has returned 148.7%.

headlines.title: Historic Brooklyn Hotel To Be Turned Into Ritz-Carlton-Branded Condos
headlines.summary: SomeraRoad and Marriott plan to turn a historic Brooklyn icon into Ritz-Carlton luxury residences.

headlines.title: Renue Hawaii Highlights Oahu Hotel Services Following Renue Systems' Inclusion in Marriott Procurement Supplier List
headlines.summary: Renue Hawaii, operating as Renue Systems of Oahu, today announced that its franchisor, Renue Systems, is included in the official supplier list for Hot Shoppe Services International, Marriott International's procurement organization. The announcement highlights the Honolulu-based business's local capabilities for Marriott hotel teams seeking specialized deep-cleaning and surface-restoration services on Oahu.

description: Marriott International, Inc. engages in the operation, franchising, and licensing of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Greater China, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. The company operates properties under the JW Marriott, The Ritz-Carlton, The Luxury Collection, W Hotels, St. Regis, EDITION, Bvlgari, Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, Westin, Autograph Collection, Renaissance Hotels, Le Méridien, Delta Hotels by Marriott, MGM Collection with Marriott Bonvoy, Tribute Portfolio, Gaylord Hotels, Design Hotels, Marriott Executive Apartments, Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy, Courtyard by Marriott, Fairfield by Marriott, Residence Inn by Marriott, SpringHill Suites by Marriott, Four Points by Sheraton, TownePlace Suites by Marriott, Aloft Hotels, AC Hotels by Marriott, Moxy Hotels, Element Hotels, Protea Hotels by Marriott, citizenM, City Express by Marriott, and Four Points Flex by Sheraton brands. It also operates residences, timeshares, and yachts. The company was formerly known as New Marriott MI, Inc. and changed its name to Marriott International, Inc. in May 1998. Marriott International, Inc. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland.
